scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Hm...after several days of observation, this place seems to be a device imprinted with the memories of an airship.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: ...that is different. I don't have any more information...

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text: ...Glad there aren't any of those pesky things here...

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text: ...I will defend this place no matter what. Go down into the airship...!!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: Flying in the air through with the strength of machinery... the development of technology is truly marvelous.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: But I feel there's a power of some kind... I think this airship won't be able to fly solely just by technology.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: I will face them here. Chaos, go down to the lower floor of the airship with Iris!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Whoa~ this is great!! The wind is so cool~!!
Hooray~ we are flying through the sky! For free on top of that!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Is it not marvelous how this huge ship can fly without the use of magic? Chaos?

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: ...?? Chaos?

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: .....Sage Kadmon..

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: What are you doing instead of listening to me!!!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Argh! Aaah~!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Humph! That's what you get for being absent-minded!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Ah...Iris!! Are you trying to kill me~!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Humph! I don't care if you die or not...

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Hey!! No horsing around on the ship!!
This is what's wrong with young humans. They have no manners! If you act up I will toss all of you off!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Oops... By the way captain, how does this big airship fly through the sky? It is so marvelous!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Huh? That's a good question.
As you can see, we heat the large boiler to boil water then use the pressure of the steam to move the pistons which turns the cogwheel and moves the turbine to turn the propeller.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Eh... So that's how this big ship floats... but now the feeling of the mystery is gone. I thought there would be some mystical device... a little disappointed...

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: That's right. This big ship can't be in the sky with just steam. So it uses an amplifier called a 'Rune Engine'.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Rune Engine? What is that?

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
It's a device that uses a magical stone.
Something about fallen fragments of a broken heart according to the legends... a ridiculous legend but that doesn't matter...

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: The stone is the so-called 'Tear of Ymir.' If put in junction with locomotive engines like steam engines, the rune exuded from the stone amplifies the energy.

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: In all honesty it is not an overstatement to say a rock the size of a thumb is moving this ship. It possesses an incredible power.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: That little thing...!!!

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text:
......huh?
Something is coming this way...

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: Alert!! Alert!! A large Wyvern unit at 7 o'clock!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: What?!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: Gre...Gremlins!! Gremlins have landed from the Wyvern!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Hm... What is this now?

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text:
Hahahaha~ You have waited long!!
Beautiful sorceress Arcana's surprise airborne monster show!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Wha...what show?

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text:
Now... Let us get started! Gremlins~!!
It's PARTY TIME~!!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Cap..Captain! This is serious!
Gremlins are all over the ship!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
What?! These are Gremlins?!
You bastards!! Come down from there now!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Captain. There is no need to be so agitated.
Gremlins are just monsters that tinker with machines. Rather...

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
You don't know what you're talking about!!
We're at an altitude of 8000!! Even a minor malfunction could lead to a deadly crash!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Argh!! Rear engine number 1!!
...This is serious! They are heading towards the engine room! We have to protect the Rune Engine!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Damn it... Where did I put my weapon...
Hey humans!! Block that nuisance while I go to the captain's room to look for my weapon!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: We have to especially stop them from getting to the Rune Engine!! If that is destroyed the ship can no longer fly!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: Damn... if only I had my weapon...

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Iris!! Let's go down to the engine room! Loki and Fenrir, hold this place!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Oh...okay! Alright... Let's go!!

scripts.speaker: Traveling Knight
scripts.text:
What are these things?
Should I cut them all down? ...No it is not enough money for me to be involved...

scripts.speaker: Passed out Drunkard
scripts.text:
Ugh... Getting drunk... hiccup
....Snore...Zzz

scripts.speaker: Wealthy man at a meal
scripts.text:
Wha... what are these monsters?!
How dare you interrupt my precious meal time! Guard! Where are you!

scripts.speaker: Free Riding Bard
scripts.text:
Whoa... Gorgeous~ Fantastic~
Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~

scripts.speaker: Airship Cafeteria Manager
scripts.text:
They might look menacing but those monsters are also customers to my cafeteria.
What would you like monster customer?

scripts.speaker: Airship Cafeteria Manager
scripts.text: Ah... Argh! Help me!!

scripts.speaker: Gambling Spirit
scripts.text:
Hey! Don't touch my cards!
Off with your hands and neck!

scripts.speaker: Gambling Spirit
scripts.text:
Huh..?!
I was just getting a feel for this and these monsters show up?! Are you trying to steal my money because I won a little? Huh?!

scripts.speaker: Airship Crew
scripts.text: This is the entrance to the engine room. Stop them from getting in!

scripts.speaker: Airship Crew
scripts.text: Damn... There are too many of them! The engine room could get overrun!!

scripts.speaker: King's Escort
scripts.text: We must not waken our sleeping King no matter what happens!
....Snore...Zzz

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Damn... They have already reached this far! Thanks to you the Rune Engine was defended.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Uh...oh!! There's a gremlin heading towards the engine room!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: .....!! We have to stop him!!

scripts.speaker: Gremlin
scripts.text: Squeak..!!
- Pop! Pop pop!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Eeek!!

scripts.speaker: Crew Member
scripts.text: Argh! The Rune Engine!! The engine room has exploded!! Fire suppression team! Put out the fire!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Damn it!! It's dangerous here! Let's get out of here first! Iris, hurry!!

scripts.speaker: Traveling Knight
scripts.text:
Ah.. Argh!!
It's going to explode! Have to go over... I have to go over to that Airship on the other side!!

scripts.speaker: Free Riding Bard
scripts.text:
Whoa... Gorgeous~ Fantastic~
Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~

scripts.speaker: Gambling Spirit
scripts.text:
What is this? Fire?
Ahhhhhh~

scripts.speaker: Airship Cafeteria Manager
scripts.text:
Is this ship.. going to fall..
However I will share fate with this ship. This ship and I are one!

scripts.speaker: Airship Cafeteria Manager
scripts.text: Ah... Argh! Help me!!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: ...These bastards just keep coming.
As expected. Our intuition wasn't wrong. It was fruitful to have followed the wave of evil and come this far.

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: ...?? Who goes there!!
Let me introduce...

Shiva! Basara! Laksmi!
We are the invincible Rangers!

scripts.speaker: Guardian Heroines
scripts.text: Guardian Heroines!!

scripts.speaker: Shiva
scripts.text: Hm? What's with the reaction? Everybody is kind of a lukewarm... Was it too much?

scripts.speaker: Basara
scripts.text: Hm, no, no. Everybody is just captivated by our great entrance.

scripts.speaker: Laksmi
scripts.text: Right, right. This much production for a hero's entrance is a bit too much!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Pu....
Puhahahahahahahahaha

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
What? Who are these idiots?!
Just look at their clothes!!
Are those stage costumes? Are they celebrities and not heroes?

scripts.speaker: Shiva
scripts.text:
Humph. You don't know what you're talking about!
Do you know how much these clothes cost? That is what's wrong with people who are dull to the latest fashion~

scripts.speaker: Basara
scripts.text: You guys! This isn't the time to be chatting like this! Let's root out the wave of evil!!

scripts.speaker: Shiva
scripts.text:
Roger, Basara! Let's end it with a swift attack!!
Huuma Metal Shuriken!! Hiyah!
- Pop! Pop pop!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: What, what are they... Absolute morons...

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text:
Oh? Gee!
An unexpected ally?
This could turn out to be a fun party~

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
Wait!
It would be better to end this party now... What is this? Did Freyja send you?

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text:
Oh. You have no fear.
How dare a mere lowly human say Freyja's name.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: As expected. You are Freyja's pawn?

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text:
...Careful. If you keep going on like that...
You will receive a divine punishment!

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text: Okay~ I will show you something good. Something to cool your heads.

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: Could it be... Wyvern's Breath?!!

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text: B.I.N.G.O. ~

scripts.speaker: Wyvern
scripts.text: Wooooo..!!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: No... no!! The ship!!
- Boom!!!

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text:
Hm...
My new clothes are ruined...

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text: Ooh.. you threw back Wyvern's Breath... an unexpected outcome. But can you withstand this one?

scripts.speaker: Wyvern
scripts.text: Wooooo..!!

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text:
Bothersome pests...
You! I will face one while you face the other...

scripts.speaker: Gremlins
scripts.text: Squeak... Kooar~!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Eek! There are still more of these!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Felrock
scripts.text: Found it! My weapon! Hehehehe

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: I will show you what happens when you attack my ship!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: I will end this with my specially manufactured Exodus Joker XIII Doom Rifle!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Just.. just a minute...
You're really going to fire that?!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Of course!
Hehehehehehehehe!
- Bang! Babang! Bang!

scripts.speaker: Gremlins
scripts.text: Urrrk!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Muhahahaha!
How do you like that!!
Muhahahahaha
- Bang! Babang! Bang!

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: Arrgh... the en..engine!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: What?! Those bastards are breaking the engine more?!! You're making me angry!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: You're the one who did it!!!
- Bang! Babang! Bang!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Bastards! Die! Die!
Muhahahaha!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: The way things are going the ship will crash because of that reindeer captain!! Stop that captain!! I'm scared...

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: How can we stop him? ...Maybe he will regain his senses if you beat him just enough to not die... I'm counting on you!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text: Oops.. I was shooting like crazy. Looks like a lot of the Gremlins are gone? Hehehehe

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: The ship is damaged because of you!!

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text: Doing our work for us. Hm, I guess this is enough?

scripts.speaker: Arcana
scripts.text: Then it's time for us to slip away...

scripts.speaker: Laksmi
scripts.text: Oh? ... There, Basara. Looks like they are retreating.

scripts.speaker: Basara
scripts.text: Of course!! They got a sense of our skill!! Hohoho~

scripts.speaker: Basara
scripts.text: On that note, one last Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
- Babang! Bang!

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
Eek!! Looks like we'll fall!!
...too short... Can't reach...

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text:
...is this the end?
...A place I can't reach like before...
Chaos...

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text: ...Grab on

scripts.speaker: Fenrir
scripts.text: Lo...ki?

scripts.speaker: Loki
scripts.text: What are you looking at? Here, come up...

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
All engines confirmed halted!!
We have to quickly escape!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Damn...
Everybody get on the lifeboats!
Board the lifeboats with the passengers being first priority! Release the lifeboats that have completed boarding!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: Wait!! There are still people remaining!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
There's nothing we can do!
If we keep stalling the rest will be in danger!! It's too bad but we have done all we can!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: But the remaining people are precious lives as well! You're going to leave them?!! Huh?!!

scripts.speaker: Captain Ferlock
scripts.text:
Yeah, you are right...
On that note I will leave you to take care of the aftermath. I'm off!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text:
Hey! Where are you going! Argh!!
I will catch you. I will kill you!!

scripts.speaker: Basara
scripts.text: It is not the time for us to be facing these trivial Gremlins.

scripts.speaker: Basara
scripts.text:
I can feel a larger wave of evil.
Let's leave these little ones to them. Let's go!

scripts.speaker: Laksmi&Shiva
scripts.text: Roger!! Ranger Flying form!!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text:
Huh? Hey!!
Where do you think you're going after destroying the ship?!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: If I catch you next time I will make sure you die!! Be nervous!! You got it?! Be ready, you yokels!!

scripts.speaker: Guardian Heroines
scripts.text: ...yokels? (Rage)

scripts.speaker: Guardian Heroines
scripts.text: The ones who denigrate and condemn the path of righteousness... We should mercilessly hand down righteous judgment, right?

scripts.speaker: Guardian Heroines
scripts.text: Die villains!! Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
- Bang! Babang! Bang!

scripts.speaker: Iris
scripts.text: Eeek!!

scripts.speaker: Guardian Heroines
scripts.text:
Ahahahahaha!!
Serves you right~!! Let's go!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text:
Iris!! Come here!!
Let's quickly find Fenrir and Loki and get out of here!!

scripts.speaker: Chaos
scripts.text: You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
